seo.title: Collapse — a small, fast file compressor
seo.description: Collapse is a small, fast, open-source file compressor for macOS, Windows and Linux. Turn files and folders into 7z, ZIP or tar archives, and back. Local-first, no tracking.

hero.lead: Drag in a file or a folder, pick a format, and get a smaller archive in seconds. 7z, ZIP and tar, in and out. Local, open-source, refreshingly simple.

download.title: Pick your platform.

systems.macos: Universal app · Apple Silicon & Intel · macOS 10.15+

features.title: Everything you need to squeeze a file. Nothing you don't.

folders.title: Files & folders
folders.body: Compress a single file or a whole directory tree; the structure survives the round-trip.

formats.title: 7z · ZIP · tar
formats.body: Standard archives any other tool can open, with five levels to trade speed for size.

both.title: Compress & extract
both.body: It goes both ways: drop an archive back in and the format is detected for you.

safe.title: Safe & private
safe.body: Extraction can never escape its folder, and nothing ever leaves your machine.

footer.meta: Open source · Local-first · No tracking · part of Cervantic
